scenarios.name: Expand and collapse project settings with the keyboard

scenario_steps.name: the Projects dialog is open in the MCAD Software
an active project with Folder Options and Options groups is displayed
the user selects the collapsed Folder Options group
the user presses the Right Arrow key
the group expands to show folder entries including Templates, Design Data and Presets
the user presses the Left Arrow key
the Folder Options children are hidden
the user selects the collapsed Options group
the user presses the Right Arrow key
the group expands to show project options including old versions to keep and unique file names
the active project remains marked in the project list
